messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — we're seeing an activation surge causing auth timeouts for a small set of VIP onboarders. Opening this thread to collect RCA + customer comms. Affected tenants: AcmeCorp (tenant-1023), BrightHealth (tenant-239), NovaRetail (tenant-331). ETA for mitigation?

alex_eng: digging now. looks like autoscaler didn't spin up extra Dedicated workers due to a change in the rolling update policy. seeing 503s and auth timeouts in the logs. will paste quick logs.

sam_se: thanks — customers already hit CS inbox. need a short status blurb we can send immediately to affected accounts.

alex_eng: quick root cause: rolling-update job set a conservative burst cap after last release (burst=0). hpa min=2 max=4 but onboarding spike needed ~10 instances. plan: bump burst->10, trigger a manual scale-up, and patch rollout to restore previous behavior. doing patch deploy in ~10m.

noah_support: ok. i'll draft the customer note. what credit/comp should we offer? cc @maria_cs for escalation rules.

maria_cs: keep it standardized — small affected accounts: one-week service credit; VIP/enterprise: 10% monthly credit + offer live office hours. escalate anything > $5k.

emily_cs: i'll run renewal-risk flags for those tenants and loop SDRs for outreach. want a short FAQ to hand to CSMs.

julia_pm: suggest an office-hours session 16:00 PST today for impacted accounts; we'll record and post. i can host with eng.

opsbot: Deploy job 1782468002 started by alex_eng — rolling update to scaler config.

alex_eng: patch is live, manual scale triggered. p50 latency back to baseline for AcmeCorp & BrightHealth; NovaRetail still catching up (queue draining). monitoring for 30m.

maria_cs: Copying draft customer email below — please review & shorten if needed. will send on approval.

maria_cs: ```
Subject: Temporary onboarding delays — immediate mitigation & next steps

Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know we experienced an onboarding delay earlier today that may have impacted items in your activation queue. Our engineers identified the root cause (autoscaler configuration during a recent rollout) and have applied an immediate fix. Instances are scaling and most customers are back to normal.

What we did: applied a targeted patch to autoscaler config and triggered a manual scale-up to remove the backlog.
What you can expect: normal onboarding processing should be restored within 30–60 minutes; we'll confirm when your queue is fully processed.
Compensation: We're offering a one-week service credit for affected accounts (VIP customers receive 10% monthly credit).
Next steps: join our office hours today at 16:00 PST (link) or reply to this message and we'll prioritize a callback.

Sincerely,
The Redwood Inference Team
```

sam_se: LGTM — short and clear. send to AcmeCorp & BrightHealth now, hold NovaRetail until we confirm full catch-up.

noah_support: Sent to AcmeCorp and BrightHealth. adding NovaRetail to follow-up once queue drains.

maria_cs: Thanks — please log this as "activation-surge-1782468000" in the incident tracker and attach short notes for the RCA. Once eng completes postmortem, we'll craft a customer-facing RCA for status.redwood.ai. cc @legal for credit approval if needed.

alex_eng: will open a full postmortem and include deploy diff + metrics. initial mitigation time: 1782468020.

emily_cs: i'll start the renewal-risk notes & schedule CSM outreach.

maria_cs: Great work team. i'll keep this thread for immediate updates; create a new doc for the formal postmortem. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Incident tag added: activation-surge-1782468000 by maria_cs.

sam_se: thanks all — monitor inbox & i'll escalate if customers push for exec contact.

maria_cs: closing temporary bridge — reopen if any regressions.
